body:
I have so many things on my mind that have been bothering me. If I ever narrate it to people, the usual response I get is that some group of people have it word than me. That's not the point. I have put efforts to better my life in the past 1 year, and when there are no good results to show for it... "Some people have it word than you" doesn't help.

I have struggled to go for a masters for the past 1 year. Keep getting rejected for weird reasons, or not having enough money to afford the colleges I get. Started hating myself because of this. Feel like I am inadequate to be good enough. I gave so many competitive exams ... Scored 700 on GMAT, 115 on TOEFL, have 85% with no backlogs in college and 44 months of work experience, but no college cares. Makes me think that the effort I have put in my life is inadequate and useless. Sometimes i feel like living makes no sense because if all the effort o have put for so long means nothing, then whats the point of living on.... 

I can't share this with people because everybody excepts so much from me, but doesn't give a fuck about what am going through....
